def act(self, obs, prev_action=None):
    if prev_action:
        self.prompt_builder.update_action(self._emitted or prev_action)
    self.prompt_builder.update_observation(obs)
    self._mount()
    frame = parse_frame(self._context(obs))
    try:
        self._chart.fold(frame)
    except Exception:                                         # noqa: BLE001
        pass                                                  # a chart is never worth an episode
    response = self.client.generate(build_messages(self.prompt_builder))
    out = copy.deepcopy(response)
    reply = extract_action(out.completion)
    action = self._decide(reply, frame)
    self._emitted = action
    self._chart.record_emission(self._chart.here if frame.grounded else None, action)
    return out._replace(completion=action)
